description: This file defines a utility enum NodeDisplayName that provides methods to determine display names for devices, based on their interface idiom and device name. It manages a set of generic names, defaults based on interface, and normalization of device names.

methods.name: isGeneric
methods.description: Checks if a given name is within the set of predefined generic device names.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Provides a default display name based on the device's interface idiom (phone, pad, or other).

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Determines the display name based on existing name, device name, and interface idiom, applying normalization and defaults as needed.

methods.name: normalizedDeviceName
methods.description: Tries to normalize the device name if it contains certain keywords, case-insensitively.
